observation.command:
set -x
# leaf first
{ echo 0 > /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/buildkit/cgroup.threads; } 2>/tmp/err1; echo "buildkit_rc=$?"; cat /tmp/err1; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/buildkit/cgroup.type
# then docker
{ echo 0 > /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.threads; } 2>/tmp/err2; echo "docker_rc=$?"; cat /tmp/err2; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.type
set +x
